title: UCSD Decorator chrome region list
description: The protected chrome regions tiers 1, 2, 3 and (for token derivation) 4 all operate on. `canvas` is deliberately not declared here — it is read from decorator-kit.json's `canvas` field, since it varies by project shape (main#main-content vs div#ag-app-canvas) while the regions below do not.

id.description: Stable identifier. Tier 3 rules reference regions by this id.

selector.description: CSS selector locating this region's root element, matched once per route.

ignoreChildrenOf.description: Selectors (relative to this region) whose children are emptied before tier 2 hashing. For content rendered from a data file — e.g. the page-navigation <ul> inside the drawer and navbar — the wrapper is chrome but its per-project contents are not, so hashing them would make every project's golden fail on its own nav links.

ignoreTextOf.description: Selectors (relative to this region) whose text is dropped before tier 2 hashing, while their elements and attributes stay pinned. For wording a site owns inside chrome markup it does not — the long and short site name in a.title-header. Tier 1 still compares the text, so the name must match on every page.
